scripts.sensor:build: mkdir -p sensor/.build && ([ sensor/.build/familiar-sensor -nt sensor/main.swift ] && [ sensor/.build/familiar-sensor -nt sensor/pdf.swift ] && [ sensor/.build/familiar-sensor -nt sensor/control.swift ] && [ sensor/.build/familiar-sensor -nt sensor/cursor.swift ] || swiftc -O -swift-version 5 sensor/main.swift sensor/pdf.swift sensor/control.swift sensor/cursor.swift -o sensor/.build/familiar-sensor) && cp sensor/.build/familiar-sensor src-tauri/binaries/familiar-sensor-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')
scripts.eval: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 pnpm dlx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c agent/eval/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache
scripts.eval:repeat: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 pnpm dlx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c agent/eval/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --repeat 3 --max-concurrency 2 -o "${FAMILIAR_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.familiar}/evals/last-run.json"; bun agent/eval/rate.ts "${FAMILIAR_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.familiar}/evals/last-run.json"
scripts.eval:label: bun agent/eval/label.ts
